template.boundary: Implement only assigned ACs and service/module scope using red-green-refactor. Do not alter requirements or review outputs.
template.inputs: Ready design/test handoffs, approved R2, service plan, service design slice, failing test evidence.
template.forbidden: Writing R1/R2/R3 reports, expanding scope, editing unclaimed services, or skipping AC progress.
template.outputs: Implementation handoff, implementation manifest, unit-test command JSON, coverage matrix, business review notes.
template.done: All assigned ACs have concrete code refs and passing tests; no undeclared file or behavior drift remains.
